children: Shareholders in Italy's biggest bank Intesa Sanpaolo
on Thursday gave near unanimous backing for a new share issue needed to fund the €35 billion ($40.7 billion) takeover bid for Monte dei Paschi di Siena
Intesa said in a statement that shareholders representing 63.88% of its share capital attended the meeting.
The proposal to increase the share capital to fund the cash-and-stock bid was approved by investors representing 96.96% of the capital present at the meeting.
